_note: ixa-baidu-2 shows a memorial statue with a domed building, and ixa-baidu-3 a temple gate — Tripura landmarks, not the airport.

ixa-baidu-1.webp.zh: 阿加尔塔拉机场机坪上的一架双发涡桨飞机：正对镜头停放，远处是特里普拉低矮的丘陵。
ixa-baidu-1.webp.en: A twin turboprop facing the camera on Agartala's apron, the low hills of Tripura beyond the airfield.

ixa-chatgpt-01.webp.zh: 航站楼白色挑檐上嵌着蓝色的机场英文名，门前棕榈与花圃沿步道铺开。
ixa-chatgpt-01.webp.en: The terminal's white canopy carries the airport's name in blue, with palms and flower beds along the paved path under an overcast sky.

ixa-chatgpt-02.webp.zh: 出发大厅里，黑色指示牌指向值机柜台与电子客票，上方展墙嵌着一排赤陶器物。
ixa-chatgpt-02.webp.en: In the departures hall a dark sign points to check-in counters and e-ticketing, with a row of terracotta pieces set into the wall above.

ixa-chatgpt-03.webp.zh: 印有靛蓝航空涂装的窄体客机停在廊桥旁，地勤人员围在机腹下作业。
ixa-chatgpt-03.webp.en: An IndiGo-liveried narrowbody sits at the jet bridge while ground crew work around its fuselage and engine.

ixa-chatgpt-04.webp.zh: 夜里航站楼顶端亮起蓝色的印地文机场名，白色张拉膜雨棚一路排开。
ixa-chatgpt-04.webp.en: At night the terminal's blue Devanagari airport sign glows above a run of white tensile canopies.

ixa-chatgpt-05.webp.zh: 隔着带刺的铁丝网，一架红尾客机正滑过跑道，背景是雾蒙蒙的树线。
ixa-chatgpt-05.webp.en: Seen past a barbed-wire fence, a red-tailed jet rolls along the runway against a hazy line of trees.

ixa-chatgpt-06.webp.zh: 低矮的候机楼铺着淡绿色屋面，格构照明塔架立在机坪边，塔台在最右侧。
ixa-chatgpt-06.webp.en: A low white terminal with a pale green roof stands behind the apron, a lattice floodlight mast in front and the control tower at the far right.

ixa-chatgpt-07.webp.zh: 登机梯靠上一架靛蓝航空客机的前舱门，蓝天里堆着大朵积云。
ixa-chatgpt-07.webp.en: A boarding stair is pushed against the forward door of an IndiGo jet beneath towering cumulus clouds.
